| # Frequency/DSM inputs {#frequencydsm-inputs-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                  |                                                                                                                                              |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The frequency/DSM inputs can be used to read frequency signals from active speed sensors and from Bosch Rexroth DSM1-x0 speed sensors.

When used to read active speed sensors, please refer to chapter [Frequency inputs](frequencyinputs.html){.topiclink}.

When used to read the DSM1-x0 speed sensor, following failures can be detected by the BSW thanks to the special hardware design and the DSM sensors characteristics:

- Short circuit to ground

- Short circuit to battery

- Open circuit

Nevertheless, in order to reach a higher diagnostic coverage, it is highly recommended to adopt the method described in [Multi-functional inputs in general](multi-functionalinputsingeneral.html){.topiclink}.
